config.exposure: Paper, owner notes, bulk_v1/atlas_v1 and existing repository analyses already inspected. Gaona count header/metadata inspected, no new response estimates viewed. This is exploratory extension, not independent confirmation.
config.decision: Determine which of seven branches has a stable RNA/context lead worth a discriminating experiment; insufficient design closes only the current test, not the biological question.

gaona.design: Separate genotype comparisons within SFFFM (3 vs 3 source mice) and ADM (4 vs 4); no suffix-based pairing or cross-media interaction inference. Mouse identities across media unresolved.
gaona.analysis: Keep counts>=10 in >=3 of all14 libraries; TMM and voom/limma separately per medium; BH per genome/contrast. Equal library replication and source-reported mice assumed. Adaptation, not exact DESeq2 reproduction.
gaona.signature: SFFFM YTactive-WT: FDR<0.05 and abs(log2FC)>0.5; up to50 per direction ordered by P then gene ID, unique symbols. Signed equal-weight mean(up)-mean(down). Requires >=5 mapped genes per side. ADM sign agreement is internal context sensitivity, not independent replication.
gaona.overlap_sensitivity: Remove all prespecified panel genes and mouse Hallmark E2F_TARGETS/G2M_CHECKPOINT from the frozen reference list; no refill. This removes overlap, not all cycling/stress biology.
gaona.interpretation: Sustained Stk3/4-loss-associated RNA response in a particular organoid context; not direct TEAD targets, YAP-vs-TAZ separation, a fibrosis classifier, or Fzd-mediated mechanism. Independent target-specific activity assay remains missing.

bulk.input: Nb2 bulk_v1 TMM-voom log2CPM and all10 frozen contrasts
bulk.score: Mean mapped-gene log2CPM per library, requires>=60% panel membership and >=2 genes; signature requires>=5 per direction. Effects compare the same panel within a study, not absolute scores across panels/studies.
bulk.uncertainty: Welch95% intervals conditional on unverified independent preparations. Six single-library deletions and nine leave-one-per-arm deletions per 3vs3 contrast use fixed normalization; ranges are influence diagnostics, not confidence intervals. No outcome-based exclusions.
bulk.N1: withdraw24-withdraw48 and agonist-withdraw48 program contrasts only; no Fzd pulse/washout or serial matched cultures present
bulk.N5: Direct source contrasts plus program response vectors; amplitude-matched causal routing cannot be identified by conditioning on post-treatment Wnt output. No PCP/calcium claim.

atlas.source: Niethamer GSE262927 existing author-annotated raw-count object
atlas.unit: sample_id x author_celltype x source day; source samples are units, not cells; author unknown labels/condition excluded
atlas.sensitivity: Keep-doublets; cell floors20 and100; reuse previous 500-UMI receptor audit for depth sensitivity
atlas.measurement: Sum counts by unit/state; all-gene UMI CPM; program mean log2(CPM+1); no cell-level p-values, no cross-study score comparison
atlas.comparisons: Within-sample epithelial states; AF1-AF2 receptor/program contrasts; CAP1-CAP2 marker crosswalk; Fzd4 endothelial profiles. Fixed day42 for descriptive within-state Spearman associations when>=5 units, no p-value claim. Day profiles categorical and source-confounded, not longitudinal animals.
atlas.scope: Coarse CAP1 includes injury-associated heterogeneity; marker crosswalk cannot recover subtype lineage. No baseline-state treatment interaction or regeneration-fate measurement.
atlas.projection: Gaona signed signature in epithelial unit/state pseudobulk only; transcriptomic similarity not predicted response or fate

config.N4: Source editing/target-scope/functional-input audit plus receptor-feedback expression context in agonist arms. No KO/blockade RNA, protein-loss map or comparable early/late perturbation cohort: compensation test ineligible.
config.outputs: Frozen membership, mapping, sample and unit coverage, bulk influences, within-source contrasts, subtype comparisons, explicit branch decisions and seven falsifiable question cards. No claim grades or A-series IDs promoted.

code_status: Analysis and figure scripts hashed again at completion; contract settings never changed silently
